description: Election Commission - M. I. Rajabdeen was Selected as the member of the Kalmunai M. C. - S. Bresnav was Selected as the member of the Hatton Dickoya U. C.
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government councils (Kalmunai Municipal Council and Hatton Dickoya Urban Council) due to resignation and death of elected members. It involves the nomination and declaration of new members under Section 66 A (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This directly relates to electoral processes and local government member appointments, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
